newsitem.title: EGYPT: Woman bites off boy's tongue for gossiping.
newsitem.headline: Woman bites off boy's tongue for gossiping.

text.p: A 17-year-old Egyptian got more than he bargained for when a woman he had spread rumours about bit off his tongue on Monday, security sources said.
They said Alaa Hassan met his fate when the woman, Bothaina Ahmed, 39, persuaded him to help her in the fields in their village near Zefta town in the central Nile Delta.
She began kissing him but then bit off his tongue.
Ahmed told police Hassan had been spreading rumours about her alleged immoral behaviour in the village. Police charged her with assault.
Hassan was taken to hospital. It is not clear if he was able to make a statement.
